metadata.domain: Large Language Model / Foundation Model / AI Platform

evidence.trl_pathway: T01 (TRL 6) and T05 (TRL 6) completing in 2 years each is reasonable, but T02 (TRL 5) with a 0-quarter development window (2030-Q1 to 2030-Q1) is essentially impossible — a TRL 5 technology cannot reach deployment-ready status with zero development time allocated.
evidence.strategic_fidelity: The declared strategy is 기술선도 (Technology Leadership), which calls for lower-TRL exploratory technologies and R&D-heavy portfolio; however, two of three technologies start at TRL 6, which is relatively mature, and the portfolio of only 3 technologies is narrow for a true leadership strategy — though the 3D spatial generation inclusion at TRL 5 shows some exploratory intent.
evidence.competitive_awareness: There is little evidence of competitor positioning or differentiation logic embedded in the technology selections or sequencing; the dependency chain (T01→T05→T02) is technically logical but does not reflect awareness of competitor timelines or gaps in the competitive landscape that this roadmap is designed to exploit.
evidence.market_timing: All three technologies complete significantly after their respective market boom windows: T01 completes 1.5 years late, T05 completes 2.75 years late, and T02 completes 1.75 years late; for 기술선도, completing 1-2 years BEFORE the boom is ideal, meaning the actual timing error is even worse than the raw numbers suggest — the roadmap is systematically late across all technologies.
evidence.patent_market_convergence: The selected technologies (LLM context collaboration, inference acceleration, 3D spatial generation) all sit in areas of active patent filing and growing market interest in the LLM/AI domain, suggesting some convergence awareness, but there is no explicit evidence that convergence zones were deliberately targeted versus coincidental alignment with hot AI topics.

strengths: Dependency chain is logically structured and violation-free, with T01 enabling T05 which enables T02 forming a coherent capability build sequence
Budget is fully utilized without violation, and all three technologies are classified as Strategic or High tier reflecting appropriate prioritization
weaknesses: Systematic late timing across all three technologies — all complete after their market boom windows rather than before them, which is particularly damaging for a 기술선도 strategy that requires preemptive positioning
T02 (생성형 AI 기반 3D 공간 생성) is allocated zero development time (2030-Q1 to 2030-Q1), making it technically infeasible from TRL 5 to completion regardless of investment
missing_technologies: Multi-agent orchestration framework (lower TRL, higher exploratory value for 기술선도)
Foundation model pre-training efficiency or novel architecture research (core R&D leadership technology)
AI safety and alignment technology (increasingly required for enterprise/regulatory positioning)
investment_issues: All budget is concentrated in only 3 technologies with no exploratory or seed-stage investments, which is inconsistent with a 기술선도 strategy that should maintain a broader R&D pipeline
T02 receives High tier investment despite having zero development time allocated and the highest uncertainty score (4.0), representing poor capital efficiency
timing_issues: T01 completes 1.5 years after boom (2028-Q1 vs 2026-Q3) — for 기술선도 should have started earlier to complete by 2025-Q3 or 2026-Q1 at latest
T05 completes 2.75 years after boom (2030-Q1 vs 2027-Q2) — most severe timing miss, inference acceleration market will be largely captured by competitors
T02 has a zero-duration development window which is physically impossible for a TRL 5 technology
